    Twisted traces in characteristic two #

    Appendix B (characteristic-two-mesh-calculations.tex) works in the centre corner over a field of characteristic two. When m + m = 0 on the target, a twisted trace kills 2 r for every r, so it factors through the quotient Rc of the free ring by the relations and by 2; in Rc we have 2 = 0.
